# googleads_shared_set (Resource)

A shared set — a reusable bundle of negative keywords (or other criteria) that can be attached to many campaigns via `googleads_campaign_shared_set`. `type` is immutable; only `name` can be updated in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_shared_set" "brand_negatives" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
  name        = "Brand exclusions"
  type        = "NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `name` (String) Shared set name. Must be unique within the account among active shared sets of the same type.
- `type` (String) NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS, NEGATIVE_PLACEMENTS, etc. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/sharedSets/{id}).
- `status` (String) Output-only status (ENABLED, REMOVED).
